functional_requirements.description: Allow users to input keywords for research purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Users can enter keywords without system errors.
The system accepts a maximum of 50 characters for each keyword.

functional_requirements.description: Validate the entered keywords to ensure they meet the required format and criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The system rejects keywords containing special characters.
The system confirms valid keywords before proceeding with data collection.

functional_requirements.description: Provide appropriate error messages for invalid keyword entries.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive clear error messages for invalid keyword formats.
Error messages are displayed in a user-friendly manner.

functional_requirements.description: Collect data related to the input keywords from various sources.
acceptance_criteria: The system collects data from at least three predefined sources.
Data collection is completed within 5 seconds for each keyword.

functional_requirements.description: Analyze the collected data to identify trends and patterns.
acceptance_criteria: The system identifies at least three trends from the collected data.
Analysis results are generated within 10 seconds.

functional_requirements.description: Generate a comprehensive report based on the trend analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Reports include visual representations of trends.
Reports can be generated in PDF and Excel formats.

functional_requirements.description: Implement a user authentication system to ensure that only authorized users can access the system and its features.
acceptance_criteria: Users must log in to access the system.
Unauthorized access attempts are logged and reported.

functional_requirements.description: Implement measures to ensure the security and privacy of the collected data, including encryption and access controls.
acceptance_criteria: All collected data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Access to data is restricted based on user roles.

functional_requirements.description: Provide keyword suggestions based on user input to enhance search accuracy.
acceptance_criteria: The system suggests at least five relevant keywords based on partial input.
Suggestions are displayed in real-time as the user types.

functional_requirements.description: Maintain a history of previously entered keywords for user reference.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view their last 10 entered keywords.
Keyword history is accessible from the user dashboard.

functional_requirements.description: Store collected data and reports for future reference.
acceptance_criteria: All collected data is stored securely for at least one year.
Reports are retrievable by users at any time.

functional_requirements.description: Allow users to export the generated trend report in various formats (e.g., PDF, Excel).
acceptance_criteria: Users can export reports in at least two formats.
Exported files maintain the integrity of the report content.

functional_requirements.description: Design a user-friendly interface that allows users to easily input keywords, view reports, and navigate the system.
acceptance_criteria: The interface is intuitive and requires no training to use.
Users can complete keyword input and report generation in under 3 minutes.

performance: The system should handle 100 concurrent users without performance degradation.
Data collection and report generation should not exceed 10 seconds.
security: User data must be encrypted using industry-standard encryption methods.
The system should log all access attempts and changes to data.
scalability: The system should be able to scale horizontally to accommodate increased user load.
New data sources should be easily integrated without major system changes.
usability: The system should provide help documentation accessible from all pages.
User feedback should be collected to improve the interface continuously.
reliability: The system should have an uptime of 99.9%.
Data backups should occur daily to prevent data loss.

constraints: The system must comply with data protection regulations such as GDPR.
Budget constraints limit the project to a maximum of $100,000.
success_criteria: At least 80% of users report satisfaction with the system's usability.
The system successfully generates reports for 95% of valid keyword inputs.

risks.risk: Data breaches due to inadequate security measures.
risks.mitigation: Implement robust security protocols and regular security audits.

risks.risk: User resistance to adopting a new system.
risks.mitigation: Provide comprehensive training and support for users.

assumptions: Users have basic computer skills and internet access.
Data sources will remain stable and accessible throughout the project duration.
dependencies: The system relies on third-party APIs for data collection.
User authentication depends on an existing user database.

ask_first: Make API calls to external services
